title: He found out he has a secret brother… then a limo pulled up 😱 | Oh Meatball Pt 4
description: Grandma Shelly dropped it: Meatball's mama had TWO baby boys. 😳 Meatball ran into the storm... and a black limo pulled up. Who's the guy in the white suit?! Part 5 tomorrow. Comment who you're siding with 👇 #MeatballAndDuchess #shorts #catdrama #ai #animation #cat #ohmeatball

line: My BROTHER?! I'm an only child!
Your mama had TWO baby boys, honey.
Then explain WHO his daddy is!
Okay, comment who you think is in that car!

new_character: Rigatoni, a slim, muscular orange tabby cat with slicked-back fur, a white suit, a gold chain and dark sunglasses, smug grin, who looks exactly like Meatball but thin. Meatball's twin brother and Pip's real father (Part 3: 'It's not Smokey... It's your brother, Meatball').
